split.algorithm: sorted IDs, NumPy PCG64 permutation, array_split

sampling.algorithm: NumPy PCG64 choice; HDF5 rows sorted after selection

pca.rng_policy: isolated NumPy random state set to the recorded PCA seed

training.scheduler: linear warmup then half-cycle cosine; epoch + batch/steps_per_epoch
training.checkpoint: last_model.pt; final raw weights at epoch 800

evaluation.aggregation: sample macro; sample SD separate from training-repeat SD
